name: n1_r3c
move: N1 Kyrie (m1_1), MOVESET.md section 1: 10 drawings, 33 f at 60 fps. Round 3c (r3b critics): A1 a real dip toward the coil (body 45%, glaive tipped back and down, not raised overhead), so the wind-up eases in; S1 a diagonal body between the coil and the contact lunge; a tapered J-crescent smear (smear v3: one smooth curve, belly on the ground line, pointed 20 px head, gradient along the stroke, inner speed line, dithered where it crosses her, gold slivers); F2 over the right shoulder with the face clear.

hero._about: Round 3c. blend = an absolute mix of other keys' states; glaive = the weapon in world; sink = the hips lowered (m) with the feet planted; wL = the left hand's grip weight at that key.

A1 drop._why: r3b critics: A1 tilted the glaive UP and back overhead, then A2 swung it ~120 deg down in one drawing. A1 is now 45% of the way into the coil (weight dropping, feet still on the idle spots) and the glaive tips back and DOWN from upright to 40 deg (the hand lowers 0.2 m), so A1 and A2 split the wind-up ~45 / 55 deg and A3 is a 1 px sink: the strike stays the biggest change

A2 coil._why: the bulk of the wind-up in one drawing

A3 coil._why: a 1 px sink into the held coil (1 px = 1.3 cm at 144 px), cloth still settling

C1 contact._why: r3 critics: C1 is the high-in-front end of the scoop, not a horizontal chest thrust

F1 carry._why: the arc continues from high-in-front over her head; the left hand lets go (F2 is one-handed)

F2 overhead._why: r3b critics: F1/F2 buried her face under the sleeve and veil; the glaive now goes over her right shoulder in the right hand and the left hand opens out

S1 strike._why: r3b critics: the S1 body was an upright, knees-in, chest-to-camera squat; now a diagonal between the coil and the contact lunge, front knee driving forward

plants._why: A1 is a weight drop: the feet stay on the idle spots until the coil (A2)

cloth_lag._why: DESIGN.md 8: stole tails trail 2-3 drawings. N1 3c: 5 f of drape delay and 70% pinned in space (3b: 4 f, 60%): the new S1 whips the glaive further, and at 4 f the tails swung through with it

cloth_world._why: r3 critics: the stole lag measured 1-2 f on screen because the root rides the body. 60% of the spring target is where the lagged drape hung in space, so the tails stay behind on screen while she moves, then swing through

cloth_dyn._why: zeta 0.3: one visible overshoot after the swing-through, then settle; N1 (r3 critics: its cloth on holds moved less than round 2's, 1.1k vs 1.6k px): hair, sleeves and tabard a little underdamped (zeta 0.26-0.28) so they swing on

smear._about: smear_v3.py (tools/motion-ai): crescent profile, gradient along the stroke, dithered over her body; see its docstring

S1._why: r3b critics: the J read as an L-shaped hockey stick (a hard corner, a stepped vertical right edge, four flat stripe bands, a 56 px head, the belly under the ground line). Now one smooth curve from the tracked tail (A3's tip, behind her on the floor) along the ground line under her feet, rising into a hooked crescent whose pointed head sits on 92% of the way to C1's tracked tip; head 20 px (MOVESET 12 px at 96 = 18 at 144), A5 leading edge, A4 -> A3 -> A2 -> A1 along the stroke, an inner speed line, dithered 50% where it crosses her; two gold slivers outside the head (MOVESET)

C1._why: MOVESET 0.6: the smear dies over the next drawings instead of vanishing: on C1 (f9-10) the head half of the J stays, thinner and one step dimmer, ending at the solid blade; gone by f11
